title: Toskar
description: Run private AI on the hardware you already own. Toskar Desktop is the packaged app. Toskar Core is the open-source engine behind it.
layoutDescription: Toskar Desktop is the packaged local-AI app. Toskar Core is the open-source headless engine: a daemon, a local web UI, and an HTTP API.
footer: Toskar Desktop and Toskar Core, from Yeix.

about.headline: Your computers. Your models. Your AI.
about.lead: Run private AI on the hardware you already own. Toskar recommends models that fit, connects your computers, and handles the infrastructure so you can just use it.

highlights.title: Stays on your machines
highlights.text: The daemon runs locally. Web access stays off until you enable Internet tools.

highlights.title: Tools without the clutter
highlights.text: Search, pages, files, shell, and git show up as status, not JSON in the reply.

highlights.title: An open engine
highlights.text: Toskar Core is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Desktop is a separate product and is not in the Core packages.

shots.title: A normal chat
shots.text: Ask in plain language. Answers come back as Markdown, and a web search shows up as a short status instead of raw tool syntax.

shots.title: Models you can actually run
shots.text: See what fits this computer, install it, and let Automatic pick one that can use tools when the question needs live information.

shots.title: More than one computer
shots.text: Pair machines on your network and let a harder job use another computer you already own.

shots.title: What the computers are doing
shots.text: See memory, the model that is running, and how fast this computer is answering.

shots.title: A health check you can read
shots.text: Heimdall shows whether the service, runtime, database, and paired computers are working.

shots.title: A local API when you want one
shots.text: The same daemon speaks an OpenAI-compatible API on this machine. LAN access stays off until you turn it on.

download.title: Download
download.description: Toskar Desktop is the packaged app. This page lists Toskar Core packages: Homebrew, headless archives, apt, deb, and rpm.
download.intro: Toskar Desktop is not in this list. The files below are Toskar Core, the open-source engine. macOS can install Core with Homebrew. Debian and Ubuntu can use apt. The release files are headless archives and Linux packages, not the Desktop app.
